# Test pe test command - validation and testing

# Basic test execution (property-based testing)
pe test config.yaml --type property --provider mock
stdout 'Test Summary'
stdout 'Success Rate:'

# Regression testing
pe test config.yaml --type regression --baseline baseline.json --provider mock
stdout 'Regression Test Results'
stdout 'No regression detected'

# Test with output file
pe test config.yaml --type property -o results.json --provider mock
stdout 'Results saved to: results.json'
exists results.json

# Generate tests from prompt
! pe test generate-tests prompt.txt --provider mock
stderr 'automatic test case generation is not yet implemented'

# A/B testing
! pe test ab-test --config-a config-a.yaml --config-b config-b.yaml --provider mock
stderr 'A/B test statistical analysis is not yet implemented'

# Cross validation
! pe test cross-validate config.yaml --provider mock
stderr 'cross-validation statistical analysis is not yet implemented'

-- config.yaml --
prompts:
  - "Analyze this text"
providers:
  - mock
property_tests:
  - name: "Consistency"
    iterations: 3

-- baseline.json --
{
  "accuracy": 0.85,
  "latency_p95": 200
}

-- prompt.txt --
Analyze the sentiment of the given text.

-- config-a.yaml --
prompts:
  - "Analyze sentiment briefly"
  
-- config-b.yaml --  
prompts:
  - "Analyze sentiment in detail"
